items.claim: Second "save frames" click while one is running breaks the run
items.note: The button is now disabled while a save runs, a second save is refused, and a run only clears the controller it owns.

items.claim: Frames save keeps downloading after the demo unmounts
items.note: An effect cleanup aborts the running save.

items.claim: Flick block held still before release is thrown at stale velocity
items.note: Velocity is now read with `getVelocity(performance.now())`. No other caller in `apps` or `packages` has the bare `getVelocity()` form.

items.claim: Flick dropped with too few moves lands off the grid
items.note: A flight that settles before the 180 ms retarget now snaps to the nearest cell when it lands.

items.claim: TrialClock loses its direction on Pause then Play, and Reverse while paused starts it
items.note: The direction is kept as its own state beside `rate`.

items.claim: VertexColor tween or stagger clicked mid-run snaps back and replays
items.note: Tweens on one node and channel add, so each new run starts from where the last one was headed and goes to the other end. The wave now turns back from the colors on screen with no jump, and the final colors are committed.

items.claim: Near-circle preset promises an exact NURBS circle it never draws
items.note: by correcting the description. Adding weights would not help: the lab's NURBS is cubic on uniform clamped knots and cannot draw an exact circle from four cardinal anchors.

items.claim: Inflection overlay misses a curvature that lands exactly on 0 at a sample
items.note: The sign is now compared against the last nonzero curvature. A straight run between curvatures of one sign still gets no marker.

items.claim: TextOutlinesDemo caches a failed font load forever
items.note: A rejected load is forgotten so the next mount retries, and the effect warns instead of leaving the rejection unhandled.
